# part id

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:partId`](gmeow-partId.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/partId>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)

The structural identifier of a MIME part within a message (e.g. '1', '1.2', '2.1.3'). Scoped to the message; the same raw content may have different partIds in different messages.

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:BodyPart`](../classes/gmeow-BodyPart.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal)
